documents.title: Create image variation
documents.description: Creates a variation of a given image. This endpoint only supports `dall-e-2`.

examples.code:
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/variations \
    -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
    -F 'image=@/path/to/image' \
    -F n=1 \
    -F response_format=url \
    -F size=1024x1024 \
    -F user=user-1234

documents.title: Create image edit
documents.description: Creates an edited or extended image given one or more source images and a prompt. This endpoint supports GPT Image models (`gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1-mini`, and `chatgpt-image-latest`) and `dall-e-2`.

examples.code:
curl -s -D >(grep -i x-request-id >&2) \
  -o >(jq -r '.data[0].b64_json' | base64 --decode > gift-basket.png) \
  -X POST "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -F "model=gpt-image-1.5" \
  -F "image[]=@body-lotion.png" \
  -F "image[]=@bath-bomb.png" \
  -F "image[]=@incense-kit.png" \
  -F "image[]=@soap.png" \
  -F 'prompt=Create a lovely gift basket with these four items in it'

curl -s -N -X POST "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -F "model=gpt-image-1.5" \
  -F "image[]=@body-lotion.png" \
  -F "image[]=@bath-bomb.png" \
  -F "image[]=@incense-kit.png" \
  -F "image[]=@soap.png" \
  -F 'prompt=Create a lovely gift basket with these four items in it' \
  -F "stream=true"

documents.title: Create image
documents.description: Creates an image given a prompt. [Learn more](/docs/guides/images).

examples.code:
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
          "prompt": "A cute baby sea otter",
          "background": "transparent",
          "moderation": "low",
          "n": 1,
          "output_compression": 100,
          "output_format": "png",
          "partial_images": 1,
          "quality": "medium",
          "response_format": "url",
          "style": "vivid",
          "user": "user-1234"
        }'

curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-1.5",
    "prompt": "A cute baby sea otter",
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024"
  }'

curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-1.5",
    "prompt": "A cute baby sea otter",
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "stream": true
  }' \
  --no-buffer
